cron_jobs.description: List of scheduled cron jobs to run within ejabberd. Each job defines when and how to execute a command (e.g., backup, cleanup, metrics collection).

name.description: Unique identifier for the cron job (used in logs and management).

schedule.description: Cron-style schedule: five fields (minute hour day_of_month month day_of_week) or @daily/@hourly etc.

command.description: Path or ejabberd command to execute (e.g., '/usr/local/bin/backup.sh' or 'ejabberdctl backup'.)

args.description: List of string arguments passed to the command.

enabled.description: Whether the job is active. Set to false to temporarily disable a job without deleting it.

description.description: Human-readable description (used only in comment lines in the generated config).
